# W8 census tables (generated by scripts/w8_score.py)

Offline reconstructions. R-rt = runtime global + full-precision B2 coefficients; R-hyb = STAR read-back global + full-precision B2 coefficients (hybrid, not a serialised field). A full refit STAR round trip is UNRUN. Native comparators: runtime field and serialised field from the H7a F `metrics.json`.

## Predictions (R-rt vs native runtime)

- P1 dose1-family median RMS: 0.1344 Å (prediction ≤ 0.15): HOLDS
- P2 in-model passes: 68 of 80 (native 22; prediction > 22): HOLDS
- median in-model relative RMS improvement: 0.475 (refuted if < 0.20): not refuted
- median in-model intercept r (frozen target): 0.981 (refuted if < 0.5): not refuted; secondary r without 0.5 R(1): 0.981
- R-hyb (vs native serialised): P1 0.1344 Å, passes 68 of 80 (native serialised 22), median improvement 0.475
